article.title: Acusativo plural inanimado
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: En plural, accusative inanimate nouns match nominative plural and animate nouns match genitive plural.
In the attested phrase Я знаю эти рестораны, the inanimate object is accusative with nominative-shaped form; the paired animate form Я знаю этих профессоров is genitive-shaped.
Cornell’s grammar attests Я знаю эти рестораны and Я знаю этих профессоров as inanimate/animate plural accusative examples.
The animacy-based syncretism applies to plural nouns of all declensions as specified in the source; lexical animacy can have exceptions.
